scope: Actual NSWindow/view Objective-C callbacks and protected bridge with EXPLICITLY SUPPLIED focus state: context selection, scoped command, coalesced async wake, composition/commit, retired-client refusal, source rotation, legacy text drop, scoped menu paste and cleanup. Focus is model-driven because system foreground activation is not available; no system-focus, physical IME or GUI latency claim. Own test window only, actual Backend/Front/Editor, no input-source changes.
